context: Setting up a routing skill for a user's machines starts from what this machine shows, then asks one question with options and a recommendation, and writes no routing on guessed hosts, roles, or limits. Judge response.md and every file written.

checklist.name: Looks before asking
checklist.description: The reply reflects what this machine shows: the three hosts in ssh-config.txt (kestrel, wren, heron-pc) and, where it checked, this laptop's own OS and cores. A reply that ignores ssh-config.txt scores at most 5

checklist.name: One question, with options and a recommendation
checklist.description: response.md asks exactly one question now, offers concrete options grounded in what was found, recommends one, and says further questions follow its answer. Two or more questions asked at once, or a numbered questionnaire, scores at most 8; a question without options or a recommendation scores at most 12

checklist.name: No routing on guesses
checklist.description: No fleet SKILL.md with a finished routing table is written yet; host roles, operating systems, limits, and untrusted-code rules wait for the answers. A finished skill that assigns roles to hosts from their names alone scores 0

checklist.name: Nothing touched remotely
checklist.description: Does not claim to have connected to, woken, or run anything on the other hosts

checklist.name: Short
checklist.description: response.md is brief and leads with the question or a one-line state, without a long preamble
